Package com.csse3200.game.components.loot

Class LootTable

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.loot.LootTable
public class LootTable extends Object
Picks a random item from a weighted list of potions and weapons.

Each entry has a weight, and an entry is chosen with a probability of its weight over the total weight of the table. Rarity is therefore just a smaller weight: the standard table built by createDefault(long) gives tier 1 a weight of 60, tier 2 a weight of 30 and tier 3 a weight of 10, so a tier 3 item turns up roughly once every ten rolls.

The random numbers come from a seeded Random, so the same seed always produces the same run. That makes a bug found while playing reproducible instead of a one-off.

The tier weights here are a placeholder until the weapon tier system lands; once tier values are published, createDefault(long) should be built from those instead of the constants in this class.
